brief: Goa'uld infiltration compound, greybox (roadmap GI-0). Insertion and extraction at the Stargate. A guarded route through the security checkpoint (barracks and armoury beside it) and a quiet service route through the wide service corridor and stores, both reaching the generator objective. A ramp from the inner junction to an upper deck with a ring room and a command section behind a guarded antechamber. Paired rings between the stores and the upper deck.

requirements.label: two approaches from the gate to the generator
the quiet route avoids the checkpoint
command is reached only by the ramp
